zh.title: 空中巴士第二季交付237架飛機 並維持全年870架目標
zh.summary: 據Simple Flying報導，空中巴士於2026年第二季共交付237架飛機。空中巴士同時維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。報導指出，維持永續的產能提升，對空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標將是關鍵要素。
body: 根據新聞媒體Simple Flying報導，空中巴士在2026年第二季度總共完成了237架飛機的交付作業。
在公布第二季度的交付數據之際，空中巴士依然保持全年總計交付870架飛機的既定目標。
Simple Flying報導分析，空中巴士能否維持永續的產能提升步調，對於其能否順利實現全年度870架飛機的交付目標而言至為關鍵。
保持永續的生產提速步調，將是空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標的要務。

en.title: Airbus Delivers 237 Aircraft In Q2, Maintains Full-Year Target Of 870
en.summary: According to a report published by Simple Flying on July 29, 2026, Airbus achieved 237 aircraft deliveries during the second quarter. In addition to these delivery results, Airbus is keeping its target of 870 deliveries for the full year. Simple Flying reported that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be crucial in order for Airbus to achieve its 870-aircraft delivery target for the full year.
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying, Airbus achieved a total of 237 aircraft deliveries in the second quarter of 2026.
Along with the second-quarter delivery figures, Airbus confirmed that it is keeping its full-year target of 870 aircraft deliveries.
Simple Flying highlighted that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be a crucial factor for Airbus as it seeks to achieve its delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year.
The delivery target of 870 aircraft for the full year remains the focus as Airbus works to maintain its sustainable production ramp-up.

zh.title: FAA要求檢查數百架波音737 MAX座椅安裝問題
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）於2026年7月27日表示，數百架在美國註冊的波音737 MAX客機座椅可能安裝不當，需接受檢查並修復。FAA要求航空公司對相關飛機進行全面排查。
body: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）於2026年7月27日表示，數百架在美國註冊的波音737 MAX客機座椅可能存在安裝不當的情況，需接受檢查並修復。FAA要求航空公司對相關飛機進行排查。
FAA指出，這些座椅存在被錯誤安裝的可疑情況，航空公司必須按照要求對問題進行修復，以確保飛行安全。
目前尚不清楚具體有多少架飛機受到影響，也不清楚座椅安裝問題是否已造成任何安全風險。FAA尚未公布詳細的檢查流程和時間表。

en.title: FAA Says Hundreds of Boeing 737 MAX Seats May Have Been Incorrectly Installed
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration stated on July 27, 2026, that seats on hundreds of Boeing 737 MAX jets registered in the United States may have been incorrectly installed and require inspection and correction. The FAA expressed suspicion that the seats were installed improperly and mandated that the issue be addressed by the operators. The scope of the affected fleet and whether any safety risks have materialized remain unclear. Further details on the inspection process and timeline have not been disclosed.
body: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration stated on July 27, 2026, that seats on hundreds of Boeing 737 MAX jets registered in the United States may have been incorrectly installed and require inspection and correction. The FAA has asked operators to inspect the affected aircraft.
The FAA expressed suspicion that the seats were installed improperly and mandated that the issue be addressed by the operators to ensure flight safety.
The scope of the affected fleet and whether any safety risks have materialized remain unclear. Further details on the inspection process and timeline have not been disclosed.
